instruction: Reject all pending Venmo payment requests from my friends and roommates.
notes: Two apps (phone, venmo) plus supervisor. Phone login uses the supervisor's phone number and venmo login the email, both obtained via supervisor.show_profile, so both logins require (profile-known). Contacts are looked up once per relationship (friend, roommate) via phone.search_contacts whose effect is (relation-searched ?r); a payment request may only be denied if its sender has a searched relationship, which structurally prevents denying requests from non-friends/non-roommates (pr-from-other stays pending). The list of pending received requests is obtained via venmo.show_received_payment_requests with status=pending. Because the number of matching requests is only known at runtime and PDDL here has no quantified goals, the problem instantiates representative requests (one per relationship) and tracks how many target requests remain via a discrete counter (count-2 -> count-1 -> count-0) that deny decrements; supervisor-complete-task requires (remaining count-0), which implies all target requests are denied. At runtime, repeat venmo.deny_payment_request for every pending request whose sender email was found by the contact searches, and complete the task with no answer.
